Umbraco.description: Configuration container for all Umbraco products.

Providers.description: OAuth provider credentials, keyed by provider name.

Slack.description: Slack OAuth app credentials and scope configuration.

SlackProviderDefinition.description:
Slack provider section (Umbraco:Automate:Providers:Slack). Inherits
the shared OAuth fields (ClientId, ClientSecret, Scopes)
from OAuthProviderConfiguration and adds the Slack-specific
UserScopes array, which is sent via Slack V2's non-standard
user_scope parameter.

ClientId.description: Gets or sets the OAuth client ID.

ClientSecret.description: Gets or sets the OAuth client secret.

Scopes.description: Gets or sets the OAuth scopes to request.

UserScopes.description:
Gets or sets Slack user scopes — requested via the user_scope
parameter in the Slack V2 authorize URL. Leave empty to request a
bot-only token.
